paragraphs: I'm a backend engineer on the founding team at OurFreedom.ai in New York. There I lead Carla, a LangGraph tool-calling agent serving about 1,000 requests a day, and I own the AWS production backend.

Before that I built an asynchronous order queue on AWS SQS and introduced PgBouncer pooling as a founding engineer at Duende Ingenious. At eQ Technologic I wrote idempotent Kafka consumers and Spring Boot microservices that kept PLM and ERP systems in sync.
I measure what I ship. I've cut hallucination rates from 16% to under 5% with a nightly 150-case eval, and cut silent order failures with retries and a dead letter queue.
Outside work I write storage and systems code from scratch, including an LSM-tree key/value store in C++ and fused attention kernels in Triton and CUDA.
